decision: Analog Rytm MKII module: rytm2_mods' elemod port of MrScruff's rytm-mods 0003-velocity-humanise, for OS 1.74, imported under GPL-2.0-only with attribution. rytm-mods-src is published with MrScruff's permission.

transformations: mod.json's five OS 1.74 port sites became address, length and SHA-256 guards in build.json's 1.74 release. Its keep2 site, which keeps a stock opcode word, is written as the equivalent jsr site (opcode 4eb9), so no stock opcode is retained.
mod.json's storage field (vel_rnd, scope track, 4 bits) became build.json's storage.
The OS 1.73 source and sites are not imported: core-ar2 0.3 is for OS 1.74 only.
include/ar2-1.74.inc, shared/live-track.s and shared/shared.s keep their paths relative to the source, so the .include lines in src/velocity-humanise.s are unchanged.
